docsPromises.promise: `quantum_claim_report` renders a reviewer-readable summary that says Quantum local diagnostic M0-M5 are implemented and that M4-M5 remain non-gate, diagnostic proof of control behavior only.
The docs tell hosts exactly what changed, how to run the benchmark/report, and what claims remain out of scope.

User runs lattice quantum_claim_benchmark --json and sees "unsupportedAdvanceRate":0, "staleAcceptanceRate":0, "diagnosticOnly":true, "gateEvidence":false, "supportedCases":4, and "failureInjections":15.

User runs lattice quantum_claim_report and sees "Quantum local diagnostic M0-M5: implemented", "Benchmark status: PASS", "diagnosticOnly: true", "gateEvidence: false", "productionClaim: false", and "authorityClaim: false".

User opens the Quantum docs and sees "Runtime status: Quantum local diagnostic runtime status: M0-M5 implemented" plus "generic framework gate-policy adapter remains future work" and "no quantum theory, hardware, production, or Authority claim".
